title: Tiny, cute camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- camera body -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='48' rx='10' fill='#5ea8e8'/>
  <!-- body top highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='32' width='72' height='16' rx='10' fill='#8ecbf5'/>
  <!-- viewfinder hump -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='26' height='14' rx='5' fill='#3f86c9'/>
  <rect x='34' y='25' width='18' height='8' rx='3' fill='#a8d8f8'/>
  <!-- lens barrel -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='22' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='17' fill='#1e5a99'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='12' fill='#7ec7f2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='7' fill='#123f70'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='54' r='3' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <!-- flash -->
  <rect x='66' y='38' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- flash sparkle -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='42' r='2' fill='#fff6c2'/>
  <!-- shutter button -->
  <rect x='20' y='26' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <!-- side grip -->
  <rect x='14' y='44' width='8' height='26' rx='4' fill='#3f86c9'/>
  <!-- cute eyes on body -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='64' r='4' fill='#123f70'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='64' r='4' fill='#123f70'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='63' r='1.4' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='63' r='1.4' fill='#eaf6ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M30 72 Q35 77 40 72' stroke='#123f70' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
